versions.changelog:
Initial release with cloud-based WeChat draft publishing support.

- Added core scripts for publishing Markdown articles with covers to WeChat draft box via cloud relay.
- Supports local to cloud conversion with dry-run by default; `--real` flag enables actual publishing.
- Configurable relay URL and API key via command line, environment variables, or `config.json`.
- Automatic local Markdown to WeChat HTML conversion; no third-party dependencies required.
- Supports image upload in articles; relay handles uploading and URL replacement.
- Includes draft deletion commands and covers basic error handling/retry logic.
首版：markdown+封面推送公众号草稿箱（微信云托管 relay）
